name: Repository onboarding
description: Explore -> architecture map -> setup checks -> guide. Produces a source-linked onboarding document.

steps.title: Explore {{repository}}
steps.deliverable: Inventory of top-level folders, entry points, and scripts
steps.acceptance: Every listed path exists in the repository.
steps.instructions: List the top-level structure of {{repository}}, entry points, package scripts, and test locations. Cite paths.

steps.title: Architecture map for {{repository}}
steps.acceptance: Each module links to its source folder; relationships are derived from imports, not guessed.
steps.instructions: Describe the modules of {{repository}} and how they depend on each other, citing import statements.

steps.title: Verify setup for {{repository}}
steps.acceptance: Commands were executed; failures reported verbatim.
steps.instructions: Run the install, build, and test commands for {{repository}} and record output. Do not claim a command works without running it.

steps.title: Onboarding guide for {{repository}}
steps.acceptance: Every claim links to a file path or a command output from earlier steps.
steps.instructions: Write an onboarding guide for {{repository}} using the map and setup results. Link sources.
